_comment: Semantic Layer builder settings. Copy to ~/.leanscale-gtm/gtm-brain.json, or just run /gtm-brain:setup.
_repo_path_help: Where the generated semantic layer repo is written. Relative to the directory you run from.
_first_metrics_help: The metrics generated in full on the first run. These three are the ones conversion rate and time in stage depend on.
_stage_timestamps_help: Probed in setup, PER FUNNEL - system_stamped | typeable | absent. Timestamp fields often cover new business only, so cycle time is measurable for one motion and not another.
_primary_funnel_stages_help: The stages of the ONE funnel being defined first. Set when setup finds a mixed stage list (new business plus renewal or expansion in the same picklist).
_excluded_stages_help: Stages deliberately out of scope for this pass. Metrics generated now must filter them out or they blend two motions.
_qualified_stage_help: The stage whose ENTRY means an opportunity is qualified. Cohort metrics use entry into this stage, never close date.
_bookings_amount_field_help: The one currency field that means bookings. Chosen in setup from the real field list on your Opportunity object.
